title: Async UI State Machine
prompt:
Write `createViewState()` — a tiny state machine for an async view. It RETURNS `{ get, load }`:

- state starts as `{ status: "idle" }`
- `load(fetchFn)` sets `{ status: "loading" }`, awaits `fetchFn()`
  - success → `{ status: "success", data }`
  - failure → `{ status: "error", message }` (err.message)
- `get()` returns the CURRENT state object (a new object each call is fine)
- calling `load` again while one is in flight is allowed — the LAST call wins (stale completions must not overwrite the newer state)

tests.name: walks idle → loading → success
tests.hint: Keep the state object in a closure; load mutates then returns the promise it created.

tests.name: failure becomes an error state
tests.hint: try/catch around the await; catch stores message and must not rethrow.

tests.name: last load wins over a stale one
tests.hint: Capture a load id when load() is called; only write success/error if the id is still current.
